input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel.
input.rationale: The Personnel section contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant, and a document-wide search for solicitation language returns nothing. Nothing restricts our hiring, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment ... for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
input.rationale: We have a convenience right on one month's written notice (effectively the preferred 30 days), IBM must keep performing through the termination date, and IBM has no convenience right of its own. Section 13.1 also lets us exit without termination charges if IBM changes terms or prices. The unquantified early-termination charge in Section 3.4(b) is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule rather than double-flagged here.

input.quote: will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
input.rationale: The 90-day non-renewal window exceeds the fallback maximum of 60 days, and renewal for a term "equal in duration to the previous term" permits automatic multi-year renewals. Redline sets 12-month renewals and a 30-day window (we can accept 60 days). Price increases are uncapped under Section 13.1 but are mitigated by our fee-change termination right, so that is noted rather than flagged.
